name: @xyva/bridge-browser
description: Browser-only authenticated WebSocket transport for the XYVA bridge protocol.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @xyva/bridge-types && tsup src/index.ts --format esm --platform browser --dts --outDir dist --clean --external @xyva/bridge-types
scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run -c vitest.config.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run test
